design.method_scope: All complete methods in committed E3 registry; retain all60knownNA; no MCS membership filtering.
design.scale: mF=mean(C_F-B), computed separately on each full comparison grid in source units; beta=b/mF, so actual fixed-breach amount is beta*mF. kappa and c are per-unit amounts.
design.unavailable_rule: Absent/changed/unequal target, origins or provided floor; invalid C<B or Y<B; nonfinite data; absentF or meanFheadroom<=0=>wholecomparisonUNAVAILABLE, no epsilon, intersection or partial method deletion.
design.missing_floor: Only QR4/Levy missing stored B identified by E0 floor_recovery metadata may recover it from exact matching frozenF trace; verify copied source bytes/SHA plus entire origin/target axes and all existing floor arrays equal. Do not create a current-floor estimate or modify E3 index.
design.primary_absence: Leave plotcomparisonunavailable, do not substitute best or another model.
design.plot: Six group facets (kappa,beta) at c=1, each shade is fraction of planned source/H/W comparisons in which fixed primary method is strictly cheaper thanF. Show full planned denominator and unknown bounds; all98per-cell regions in CSV. Related-cell fraction is descriptive; no pooled independence.
design.ties: Exact floating equality; cheaper iff difference<0. No threshold/tolerance chosen from outcomes.
design.report: All methods and all189parameterpoints percomparison in CSV with primitive amounts/strictbreaches, percell primary regions and source-summary figures. Keep original primary references distinct in method inventory; no new models or forecasts.
design.interpretation: Per-issued-report cost, not sum over overlapping holding periods, optimized policy, observed coefficients or common-dollar cross-market portfolio. The illustrative/not-observed-real-cost sentence appears once in Limitations.
design.code_and_input_gate: Commit implementation after artificialtests, seal all new costcode,protocol,index and exactprivateNPZ fingerprints before single actualcostrun. Exclusiveoutputs; no scientific retries or changes togrid.
